case_title: State of U.P. v. Chhotey Lal
trial_court_outcome: Convicted of rape and sentenced to 7 years RI
neutral_facts: The accused, along with two others, kidnapped the victim from her village and took her to a city. The victim was kept in a rented room for several days where one of the accused had sexual intercourse with her against her will. The victim's brother reported the incident to the police after a delay of ten days, which was explained as due to family honor concerns. The victim was medically examined and found to be approximately 17 years old. The trial court convicted the accused of rape and sentenced him to seven years of rigorous imprisonment. The High Court initially acquitted the accused, but the Supreme Court overturned this decision, restoring the trial court's judgment.
